# Engine: --base <ref> starts a run from any commit

## What to build

Add a `--base <ref>` option to the run command of `packages/graph-execution`. A run with `--base` takes its starting commit from that ref instead of the checkout's HEAD, so graph-manager can start a run from any branch without checking it out. Combined with `--no-merge`, the run never touches the checkout. The spec is `docs/prd/isolated-workspaces.md`; read its Decisions and Requirements sections for this slice.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` (lines 215–240: options; 130–175: how `merge` and `ctx.startBranch` are passed) — where the option is declared and threaded.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts` (lines 59–94) — `Environment`, `EnvironmentOptions`, `checkEnvironment`: today `startingCommit = currentHead(repo)` and `startBranch = currentBranch(repo)`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/startup.ts` (lines 33–100) — `StartupOptions` and `startup`: the dirty-tree warning.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (lines 170–200, 290–300, 650–680) — `targetBranch` is recorded when `opts.merge !== false && ctx.startBranch`; `mergeResult` applies to the checkout.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/paths.ts` (`RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS`) — the list of options that take a value; `cli.test.ts` keeps it in sync with `--help`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/git/` — the existing helpers (`resolveRef`, `currentHead`, `currentBranch`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `EnvironmentOptions.base?: string`. When set: `startingCommit` = `git rev-parse --verify --quiet <base>^{commit}` (throw `new UsageError(\`unknown base: ${base}\`)` when it fails); `startBranch` = `base` when `refs/heads/<base>` exists **and** it is the branch checked out in the repo, else undefined. Also return `baseIsCheckedOut: boolean`.
- **GOTCHA**: `UsageError` gives exit code 2.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/startup.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `StartupOptions.base?: string`, passed to `checkEnvironment`. Print the uncommitted-changes warning only when there is no base or the base is checked out.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` and `state/paths.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `.option("--base <ref>", "start the run from this branch or commit instead of HEAD")` next to `--no-merge`; pass it to `startup`. Add `"--base"` to `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS`. When `--base` names something other than the checked-out branch and merge is on, log `not applying: <base> is not checked out here` and run as `--no-merge` (no `targetBranch`). `--resume` ignores `--base`.

### ADD tests
- **PATTERN**: `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/startup.test.ts` and `cli.test.ts` (temporary repos via the fixtures in `src/__fixtures__`).
- Cases: `--base other --no-merge` with `--provider fake` → `graph/<run-id>`'s first parent chain starts at `other`'s commit and the checkout's `git status --porcelain` and HEAD are unchanged; `--base nope` → exit 2, message `unknown base: nope`; `--help` lists `--base`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `graph-execution <tasks> --spec <spec> --provider fake --base other --no-merge` on `main` builds from `other` and leaves the checkout unchanged.
- [ ] `--base nope` exits 2 with `unknown base: nope`.
- [ ] Without `--base` nothing changes.
- [ ] `npm test -w graph-execution` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-execution -- startup cli
```
